text.content:
Orators are as good at reading someone's heart as they are at rounding up allies for their cause.

SKILLS

Condemn · SL max 6

As an action during a conflict, spend 5 Mind Points to make an Opposed (INS + WLP) Check (+SL) against one enemy that can hear and understand you. If you succeed, that enemy loses (SL × 5) Mind Points, suffers dazed or shaken (your choice), and all sources of damage deal +(SL) extra damage to them until the start of your next turn.

Encourage · SL max 6

As an action, spend 5 Mind Points to speak to an ally who can hear you. That ally recovers (SL × 10) Hit Points and, during a conflict, may immediately raise one of their Attributes one die size (maximum d12) until the start of your next turn.

Hero with a Thousand Faces · SL max 3

Record each Theme change and its cause. Every 5 recorded changes: each player gains (SL) Experience Points and you gain an additional Identity built from the story your Themes tell.

Invigorating Speech · SL max 6

As an action, spend 15 Mind Points to create an Inspiration Clock with (SL) sections; it lasts until you rest or it is completely filled. Whenever an ally would suffer a status effect, you may fill one section of your Inspiration Clock instead — the status effect still applies to you as normal.

My Trust in You · SL max 2

When another Player Character who can hear you rolls a Check, you may spend 1 Fabula Point and invoke one of their Traits or Bonds to allow them to reroll any or all dice in that Check, or to improve the result. If you have a Bond toward that character, they also recover (SL × 10) Mind Points.

Persuasive · SL max 2

When you succeed on a Clock Check that relied on charm, diplomacy, deception or intimidation, you may spend up to (SL × 20) Mind Points, filling one extra section for every 20 Mind Points spent this way.
